title: Memory-driven price rises and AI shopping change how we sell PCs
summary: HP and Dell expect memory prices to keep rising in 2027 with a weak PC market; European notebook revenue rose 16% on pricier models; Klarna joined Adyen's agentic suite; Walmart put Black Friday deals in Meta's Muse agent.

points.headline: Memory costs lift PC prices while unit demand stays soft into 2027
points.detail: HP and Dell expect memory prices to keep rising in 2027 and the PC market to stay weak; European notebook revenue rose 16% on pricier models. We should plan pricing, mix and inventory for fewer units at higher prices.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a deal-discovery and checkout channel
points.detail: Walmart brought Black Friday deals to Meta's Muse agent, Target's assistant shows early sales lift, and Klarna joined Adyen's agentic suite. We should test how our products, promos and financing appear in agent-led shopping.

points.headline: Holiday shoppers lean on AI while small businesses spend more
points.detail: NRF finds half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI; Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending. Our store should make listings AI-readable and push business bundles and financing.

points.headline: Walmart's fulfillment speed is winning share in electronics channels
points.detail: Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% in Q3 on delivery speed, and Best Buy computing sales held despite higher memory prices. Our marketplace delivery promises need to keep pace.
